description: This file defines the Subscription class within the OpenCart e-commerce system, specifically in the checkout model namespace. It contains methods for managing subscription entities, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving subscription data, as well as managing subscription history and status updates. The class interacts with the database directly to perform CRUD operations related to subscription lifecycle management.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Implements subscription management functionality within the checkout process, including CRUD operations, status updates, and historical tracking.

methods.name: addSubscription
methods.description: Inserts a new subscription record into the database, calculating trial and remaining periods based on input data.

methods.name: editSubscription
methods.description: Updates an existing subscription record with new data such as order details, options, trial, and status information.

methods.name: deleteSubscriptionByOrderId
methods.description: Removes a subscription record based on the associated order ID.

methods.name: getSubscriptionByOrderProductId
methods.description: Retrieves subscription data for a specific order ID and product ID, decoding related JSON fields.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a record to the subscription history, logging status changes and comments.

methods.name: editSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Updates the subscription status in the database.

methods.name: editTrialRemaining
methods.description: Updates the remaining trial period for a subscription.

methods.name: editDateNext
methods.description: Updates the next scheduled date for the subscription.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of subscriptions based on filter criteria, including join with order and status tables.
